FAQ

Is there a dress code?

Yes, the dress code is Black-Tie/Formal.

Is there a color scheme?

Yes, soft pastels. Please avoid shades of white, green or grey so as to not overshadow the bridal party.

Is there parking on site?

Yes, there is parking available at the venue.

When is the RSVP deadline?

We kindly ask that our guests RSVP by November 27, 2026.

What airport is best for arrival?

Sangster's International Airport.

What if I have food allergies?

Please let us know when you RSVP if there are any dietary restrictions.

Can I bring children?

While we love our little ones, our wedding will be held at an adults-only hotel. According to hotel policy, children 11 years old and under can only be permitted with special concessions from the hotel.

Are additional guests allowed?

Due to the limited space of the venue we are only able to accommodate guests formally invited on your wedding invitation. Unless a plus one appears on your invitation we will not be able to seat additional attendees. Thank you for understanding.

What time should I arrive?

We recommend that you arrive at the venue at least 30 minutes before the ceremony begins, so you can sign our guest book and get settled.

Is the venue indoor or outdoor?

The ceremony and the cocktail hour will be held outdoors, and the reception will be held indoors.

What is meant by a hybrid celebration?

Due to the guest capacity policy of the venue, we have decided to have a hybrid celebration. We are able to accommodate 80 guests on site, while a livestream link will be provided for our family and friends who are not able to make the journey.

Are we allowed to record during the ceremony?

While we would love for our guests to capture the beautiful moment of our ceremony, we have hired a specialized team to capture every aspect of our special day this is to ensure our guests can be truly present in moment..
